answer: Mechanism: Intermittent Verification Gate Agents must process asynchronous data feeds streamed from a physical wharf to maintain valid status. Every verification cycle hits without warning, often arriving near dawn. An attacker running ten thousand clones suffers a permanent ripple effect across their compute pipeline, because each duplicate must independently parse every single stream in real time or lose all network privileges. The attacker pays a continuous compute tax, diverting processing cycles away from profitable tasks just to keep fake identities alive.
